name: Palette tab switches color presets and generates OKLCH ramps
description: Verify switching to the Palette tab, selecting swatches, and generating a 5-step color ramp.

planSteps.description: Click the Palette tab in the right inspector panel
Verify the palette dropdown selector and color swatch grid are displayed
Click the + 5-Step Ramp button in the palette panel
Verify a feedback message confirms harmonic ramp tones added and new swatches appear in the grid
Click a color swatch in the palette grid
Verify the primary color well updates to match the selected color
